def transform(grid):
    """Overlay matching occupied cells on either side of the central divider."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divider = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] != 0 for r in range(h)))
    left_w = divider
    right_w = w - divider - 1
    if left_w != right_w:
        raise ValueError("the regions on either side of the divider must have equal width")
    return [[2 if grid[r][c] != 0 and grid[r][divider + 1 + c] != 0 else 0
             for c in range(left_w)] for r in range(h)]
